name: aasb-aas-python-api-builder
description: Install the "AAS Python Development" workflow plugin from Agentic Awesome Skills.

interface.longDescription: Python language and framework implementation. Implement and test Python code, async workflows and FastAPI or Django services with schema validation and bounded external API retries. Recommended for: Python backend teams, FastAPI and Django builders, API maintainers. Not for: Cross-stack architecture and API lifecycle decisions: use Backend & API Platform., Production deployment without a separate explicit authorization.. Covers Python Pro, Python Patterns, and 11 more skills.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Python service and use its existing FastAPI or Django stack. Implement the requested endpoint with Pydantic or framework-native validation, authentication boundaries, error responses and tests. Update the API contract and report the checks actually run.
Use this plugin to review this Django API for structure, performance, OpenAPI coverage, and test coverage.
Use this plugin to refactor this Python service toward clearer API and async patterns.

Review this project for the added coverage: Apply authorization, validation and security checks to service boundaries; Review analytical query performance without changing metric semantics; Implement replay-safe bounded retries that respect provider wait hints. Use only the relevant skills and existing stack. Report observed checks and limitations; prepare drafts before external or production actions.
